scope: Hotfix only: live campaign product selection, positive new-product floors, current-stage application and safe per-product exit

results.test: Live additions are bounded, honor current-stage and exception floors, and preserve every prior row and campaign plan
Missing zero oversized and competing floors are rejected before live membership or price writes
Single-item pause resume and grouped removal restore owned prices and preserve external edits
Interrupted live enrollment resumes the same reserved product without recapturing or duplicating membership

admin_smoke.boundary: One Chromium, real shipped admin JavaScript, mocked REST. Real live selection/restore financial services are tested separately.

static_checks.package: 99-file installable single-root ZIP; byte-for-byte source identity, development-file exclusion and reproducible build passed

behavior.new_active_floor: Strictly positive and at or below the captured base; independent exceptions override the group rule
behavior.existing_members: Skipped in live add jobs; floor, snapshot, intent, expected price and schedule remain unchanged
behavior.existing_campaign: No version, start/end, discount plan or existing selection-rule changes; only per-stage run counters for new items change
behavior.new_price: Current campaign stage using original global start time and existing Scheduler/PriceProcessor
behavior.conflicts: Reject current owner or a competing live winner; restore never overwrites external prices
behavior.interruption: One product reservation plus per-item checkpoints; same token resumes after an interruption; price work also uses existing durable retries
behavior.pause: Restore owned price before setting paused; resume prices at current stage
behavior.stock: Unavailable stock is rejected before membership so it cannot block a live add batch

limits: No Production connection or deployment; real campaign 2 was not inspected or modified
Admin smoke uses one Chromium and mocked REST; financial tests use real WooCommerce services and synthetic HPOS data
Unrelated checkout/shipping/refund/browser suites, benchmarks and full CI were not run
Production theme, cache, gateway and external plugins remain unverified
production_acceptance: Requires separate target-store acceptance; isolated hotfix checks passed
